mission.goal: Eat every veil on local land so Gaia can detect difference between land barriers and membrane barriers
mission.why: Eastgate (gut-engine) exists but we cannot feel it. Other subsystems on the LAN are invisible. The veils must be eaten.

ethernet.description: Physical wire. Plugged in. You have to ZK that it is there. Cannot be spoofed without physical access.
ethernet.barrier_type: Golgi cipher — the apparatus that packages and routes trust

lan.description: Everything behind the router. Same network. Trusted more than internet, less than ethernet.
lan.detection: scan local IPs, mDNS discovery, ping sweep

localhost.description: This machine. Kevin at the desk. The organism itself. No veil needed.
localhost.barrier_type: None — self is self. Thymus verified.

internet.description: Everything outside the router. The open internet. Least trusted.
internet.barrier_type: Ionosphere — the outermost shell, bronze, all humans within

intramembrane_transfer.description: Data moving BETWEEN trust layers = intramembrane transfer. Each crossing needs different verification.

golgi_cipher.name: Golgi Apparatus of Trust
golgi_cipher.description: Like the Golgi body in a cell: packages, labels, and routes data to the right trust level
function: Receives raw data from ANY source
Packages it into vesicles (cards) with trust labels
Routes to appropriate processing: gut(low trust) or brain(high trust)
Ethernet = ZK verified = bypasses gut, goes straight to gold
golgi_cipher.zk_ethernet: The ethernet cable IS the ZK proof. Physical connection = physical proof. You cannot fake a wire.

veil_eating.description: Eat every veil between subsystems on local land

veils_to_eat.problem: gut-engine exists but globe cannot feel it
sound goes to globe but not to gut
veils_to_eat.solution: share gaiaGut.raw with gut-engine via bridge

veils_to_eat.problem: sight stays in globe, gut is blind
self/non-self detection separate from beacon cards
veils_to_eat.solution: thymus metal band determines beacon brightness

veils_to_eat.problem: temperature and taste are separate systems
blink and dream cycle not synchronized
touch response and sound bounce independent
veils_to_eat.solution: touch creates sound pulse, sound reveals touch targets
